claimed_scope: Implement the smallest deterministic preparatory transaction and durable-state-lineage primitive for hostile-twin install/update/rollback testing. The component validates exact release identity, predecessor generation/state digest continuity, deterministic attempt receipts, injected failure/rollback outcomes, and explicit twin-only evidence scope. Repository source/tests/CI only. It does not select or execute the production installer, install a release ZIP, mutate a host/twin, perform package-manager/network work, claim restart/readback, attach VPS bridges, or grant T1-T4/physical/runtime/effect/completion/GRID/GWT/J-Space/training credit.
required_invariants: release identity and state-lineage identity are explicit and deterministic
update requires an exact predecessor generation and state digest rather than inferred continuity
rollback can reference only the exact predecessor release/state lineage supplied to the transaction
injected failure produces an explicit failed or rolled-back receipt and never a synthetic success
same normalized transaction input yields the same transaction digest and plan
component output is noncanonical hostile-twin test input and cannot grant target/runtime/completion credit
forbidden: release ZIP installation or package-manager/network side effects
VPS or physical target mutation/runtime credit

negative_evidence.resolution: isolated mutable fixtures without weakening the product gate

next_exact_action: Exercise the exact release ZIP and accepted transaction/state-lineage contract inside an admitted hostile target twin, inject update failure, verify exact rollback/readback to the pre-attempt lineage, and persist exact-source runtime receipts before any target-runtime or T-level promotion.
